beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:00.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. jobgether-jobgether:lever:06298888-f6d2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quantum Computing/Cryptography Engineer based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to help organizations prepare for the rapidly evolving security challenges created by quantum computing. You will research and implement quantum-resistant cryptographic solutions while helping modernize enterprise security architectures. The position combines advanced quantum computing knowledge with practical cryptography, cybersecurity, and systems engineering. You will assess existing environments, identify quantum-related risks, and develop migration strategies toward post-quantum standards. You will also contribute to crypto-agile architectures and integrations across PKI, identity, cloud, network, and application environments. Working alongside cybersecurity architects, engineers, researchers, and system owners, you will translate emerging quantum-security requirements into practical solutions and long-term modernization roadmaps. Research, design, and evaluate quantum-resistant cryptographic solutions, including post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms and emerging quantum-safe security standards. Assess enterprise systems, applications, protocols, and cryptographic implementations to identify vulnerabilities and risks associated with current and future quantum computing threats. Design and implement cryptographic modernization and migration strategies for transitioning from traditional public-key cryptography to quantum-resistant algorithms. Develop, prototype, test, optimize, and integrate cryptographic algorithms, libraries, APIs, and security components into enterprise applications and infrastructure. Evaluate and implement NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptographic algorithms, including appropriate key-establishment and digital-signature mechanisms. Conduct cryptographic testing, security analysis, performance benchmarking, and interoperability testing to validate implementations and identify potential weaknesses. Develop crypto-agility architectures that enable organizations to efficiently replace or update algorithms, protocols, certificates, and keys as security requirements evolve. Support the integration of quantum-safe cryptography with PKI, identity management, TLS, VPNs, cloud platforms, network security systems, applications, and data-protection technologies. Collaborate with cybersecurity architects, software engineers, researchers, and system owners to translate quantum-security requirements into practical technical solutions and implementation standards. Produce technical documentation, architecture guidance, migration roadmaps, cryptographic inventories, risk assessments, and recommendations supporting post-quantum readiness. Assess organizational cryptographic inventories and establish migration priorities based on risk, technical dependencies, and future quantum threats. Provide technical and policy guidance aligned with NIST post-quantum cryptography standards, including FIPS 203, FIPS 204, and FIPS 205. Communicate complex quantum-security risks and modernization recommendations effectively to both technical teams and non-technical leadership. Apply project-management and configuration-management practices appropriate to large-scale enterprise and government technology environments. Requirements 10+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 5 years of experience focused on quantum computing and cryptography within a large enterprise or government environment. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Assurance, Information Security, Information Resource Management, or a related field. sierrastudio-sierra-studio:ashbyhq:6eb3f.description: 🏔️ ABOUT SIERRA STUDIO Sierra Studio is an innovative product development firm dedicated to empowering founders and business leaders in their quest to create impactful, meaningful products. Our team of experienced professionals is committed to delivering high-quality solutions that drive business growth. We prioritize a culture of good vibes, open communication, and continuous learning, providing our team members with the opportunities and resources they need to thrive. This role is with one of the teams we help build through our staffing partnerships. When you apply, Sierra manages the hiring process, but you'll be hired directly by and work within the client company. 🏢 ABOUT THE COMPANY Our hiring partner is a performance creative agency that makes ads for brands on TikTok, Meta, and TikTok Shop. They work with 2,000+ creators and produce thousands of videos per year. Their internal portal handles the entire workflow: creator onboarding, contracts, campaign management, content review, and payments. They're now building a Creative Engine that turns creative strategy from gut instinct into a data-driven process. Data today lives in too many disconnected places — the Creative Engine brings it all into one central home, across performance creative, TikTok Shop, and TikTok LIVE, so the team can derive real insights instead of digging through separate platforms. AI watches and tags every video they produce, breaking each one into the hooks, formats, and patterns that drive results, and connects that to the sales and engagement data flowing out of Shop and Live. It all feeds one queryable system, a "brain" a strategist can ask "what are the top hooks for beauty this week?" and get a real answer back. The team reaches it through dashboards, Slack, and Cowork. It starts as the internal engine the creative team runs on, and over time clients log in to it too — this is the core of where the company is headed. How they work: - Small team, high ownership. You own your work end to end, from idea (or data model) to deployed UI. No committees. - AI-assisted everything. Claude Code and coding agents are used daily as a real part of the workflow. - Ship constantly. They deploy to production multiple times per day. Scope stays small and tight. - Remote, async. Communication happens via Slack and GitHub. No standups or status meetings for the sake of meetings. 🖼️ ABOUT THE ROLE Our hiring partner is looking for a Technical Product Manager to own the Creative Engine, the data and intelligence layer behind the agency. You'll sit at the intersection of creative, performance, and engineering, and your job is to turn what the best strategists know intuitively into a system the whole company can query. This is a product role with a creative soul and a technical spine. You understand what makes an ad win, and you can translate that into data models, specs, and roadmaps that engineering can build. When a strategist asks "what are the top hooks for beauty this week?", you're the person who designed the system that answers it. This is a data-first product — the architecture comes before the app, and you'll help define both. 🔨 WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the product vision and roadmap for the Creative Engine, translating creative strategy and performance insights into a data product the whole agency runs on. - Define the insights that matter — work with creative strategists to turn fuzzy questions ("what are the top hooks for beauty right now?") into structured, queryable outputs. - Partner with engineering on the data foundation, shaping the data model and pipelines that pull, structure, and connect data across performance creative, TikTok Shop, TikTok LIVE, Meta, and the creator portal. - Design the "brain" — define how viral organic references, top-performing ads, and creator history come together into creative inspiration on demand, not just a keyword search. - Spec how the team accesses the Engine: dashboards, tag browsers, and insight queries strategists u
